name: DelveTreasure
predicate: treasure keyword OR Equipment OR Item, minus Junk/Companion suffix
note: The wide one, and the least filtered pool in the game: the delvebytag short-circuit skips its own Unique / Grounded / canBeAcquired / excludeFromConjurations filters. Most candidates are not treasure-keyword cards.

name: DelvePirateParlor
predicate: treasure keyword OR map keyword OR Location category, minus owned Uniques and Unplayable, plus 1-5 tatoos
note: Ignores set selection, so it can offer cards from disabled expansions. Ends in `play`, not `obtain`, so the pick is played rather than added to the deck. Size counts base candidates: notes/15 §3 quotes 26, this minus the one Unplayable Location (Lost Lagoon), and excludes both the run-state-dependent owned-Unique removal and the tatoos.

name: keyword, acquirable
predicate: treasure keyword AND canBeAcquired AND PlayerCanCastCard
note: Differs from C by one bool. This is why two events both labelled treasure hand out different cards.
